description: This file defines interfaces, stub, and proxy classes for a COM-like IUnknown interface, including mechanisms for remote procedure calls, proxy management, and interface querying within the WPEFramework RPC system.

classes.name: UnknownStub
classes.description: Base class for stub implementations of the IUnknown interface, providing virtual methods for conversion, interface identification, and handling messages.

classes.name: UnknownStubType
classes.description: Template class extending UnknownStub, representing a stub for a specific interface with multiple methods, managing method handlers and interface conversions.

classes.name: UnknownProxy
classes.description: Proxy class managing remote references, communication, and interface querying for a remote IUnknown implementation, including reference counting and proxy lifecycle management.

classes.name: UnknownProxyType
classes.description: Template class implementing the interface, acting as a client-side proxy that forwards calls to the remote UnknownProxy, managing reference counting and interface querying.

methods.name: Length
methods.description: Returns the number of methods handled by the stub or proxy.

methods.name: Convert
methods.description: Converts incoming data to a specific interface pointer.

methods.name: InterfaceId
methods.description: Returns the interface ID associated with the stub or interface.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Handles incoming messages based on method index.

methods.name: AddRef
methods.description: Increments the reference count of the proxy.

methods.name: Release
methods.description: Decrements the reference count and potentially destroys the proxy.

methods.name: QueryInterface
methods.description: Queries for a specific interface by ID.

methods.name: Message
methods.description: Creates a message for invoking a method.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Invokes a message on the communication channel.

methods.name: Complete
methods.description: Completes a proxy or stub operation, possibly releasing resources.
